message:
fix(OP-36): restore periodic refresh fanout into native RC6 jobs

Selectively adapted ea0a3ec from fix/data-delete-semantic-profile. Preserve generated_artifact.v3 admission and isolated-only execution; do not restore the legacy in-process loader. Forward input parameters to the worker. 62 periodic-refresh, worker and ledger regressions pass on Python 3.13; ledger unit tests explicitly mock admission, not sandbox enforcement.
